    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start LAN party planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectGames" name="Ask friends which games they want to play">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GamesReceived" name="List of games received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Plan date and check games in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Date_Merge" name="Date search merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_AwaitAnswers" name="Date replies received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Date_Split" name="8 or more people agree?" default="Flow_11">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check which games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Games_Split" name="Games missing?" default="Flow_14">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Games_Merge" name="Games checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBeer" name="Determine how much beer is required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Beer_Split" name="Enough beer?" default="Flow_20">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Beer_Merge" name="Beer checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CollectGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CollectGames" targetRef="Event_GamesReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Event_GamesReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Date planning" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Game check" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Merge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Event_AwaitAnswers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Event_AwaitAnswers" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">attendeesConfirmed >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No, appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">missingGames > 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Task_CheckBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="Not enough" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">beerMissing > 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Enough" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that a period of gathering answers, games or other items continues until a stated condition is reached (for example, 'until enough people are free' or 'until all replies are in'), and a later decision or synchronization depends on the outcome of that period: Model the continuing period as an intermediate catch event placed after the activity that starts the gathering and before the gateway that uses its outcome. Do not connect the activity directly to that gateway, and do not fold the waiting period into the activity or the gateway.

rules.instruction: When the description says the flow pauses for a stated span of time, such as a few hours, while people reply or items are gathered, and the next step begins only after that pause ends: Model the pause as an intermediate timer catch event placed after the step that starts the collection and before the step or gateway that uses the collected result. Do not model the pause as a task, and do not skip it by connecting the collection step directly to the next step.

rules.instruction: When the description says that an ongoing collection period continues until a stated condition is met, and a later decision or synchronization depends on the result of that period: Model the continuing period as an intermediate catch event (for example, a conditional event that waits for the stated condition) placed after the activity that starts the collection and before the gateway that uses its result. Do not connect the starting activity directly to that gateway, and do not fold the waiting period into the activity or the gateway.
rules.situation: the description says that information must be gathered from several other people before the next decision or synchronization, and the activity that requests that information is followed by a decision or join that uses the collected answers

rules.instruction: When the description says the process waits until a group of people has replied or until a set of items has been collected before the next decision or step: Model that wait as an intermediate catch event placed after the request task and before the gateway or activity that uses the collected replies or items, so the waiting step is explicit in the flow rather than merged into the request or decision.
rules.situation: the description says the process waits until a group of people has replied or until a set of items has been collected before the next decision or step

rules.instruction: When the description asks a group of people to each supply a quantity or answer, and a later decision depends on the collected answers, but the description does not say how or when the collection ends: Model the collection of the group's answers as an intermediate catch event placed after the request activity and before the decision gateway that uses the collected answers. Connect the request activity to the catch event, and the catch event to the decision gateway. Do not connect the request activity directly to the decision gateway, and do not fold the wait into the request task or the decision gateway. Keep the decision's branches as separate flows after the gateway.

rules.instruction: When the description says that after an exclusive check of whether an available quantity or set of items is sufficient, a shortfall must be covered by a stated obtaining action (for example, acquiring what is still needed) before the process goes on: After the exclusive decision that checks sufficiency, add a task on the insufficient branch that performs the stated obtaining action, named after the description's wording. Route that task into the same continuation the sufficient branch reaches, so the shortfall is handled explicitly before the process proceeds. Do not leave the insufficient branch as a bare sequence flow to the join.
